name: When should I consider hiring a luxury property sales representative?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a luxury property sales representative?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a luxury property sales representative when selling a high-value home, typically over $1 million, in a competitive market. These specialists possess the expertise to accurately price, market, and negotiate properties that require a distinct approach beyond standard real estate practices. For properties in prime South Florida locations like Miami Beach or Coral Gables, a representative can help navigate buyer expectations and market nuances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a luxury property sales representative when selling a high-value home, usually over $1 million, especially in competitive markets that require specialized marketing and negotiation.
